commit.message: ci(node): advance shared lanes to Node 22

intent: Advance the existing exact shared Node CI pin from 20.20.2 to an exact Node 22 patch so the dashboard and terminal lanes remain in policy lockstep and the Helm Ink 7 migration can declare Node >=22 without weakening the polyglot supply-chain contract.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,pytest,sys; p=pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/tests.yml'); t=p.read_text(); old='node-version: \"22.14.0\"'; new='node-version: \"22\"'; (t.count(old) == 2) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old,new)); sys.exit(pytest.main(['-q','tests/test_polyglot_ci_contract.py','-k','pins_exact_node_version']))"
negative_controls.name: floating-node-pin-is-rejected

honest_blockers: This PR changes the CI toolchain pin only. The terminal manifest and Ink dependency migration remain in ticket #1402.
interface_mismatches: Ink 7 requires Node >=22, while both governed Node CI lanes are pinned exactly to 20.20.2 and the polyglot contract requires them to remain identical.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped CI pin commit to restore both lanes to Node 20.20.2.
